description:
This robot can repot plants, make pour-over coffee, assemble kits, and even cook pancakes. 

And all of those tasks were learned from a single video demonstration.

Skild AI’s new S1 model can recreate tasks lasting up to 10 minutes, with dozens of individual step, WITHOUT any fine-tuning or additional training.

It’s basically prompting...but for robots.
